title: Agent Execution Integrity Benchmark (AEIB) Core v0.2.4: Open Specification and Offline Verification Harness
description: The Agent Execution Integrity Benchmark (AEIB) Core v0.2.4 (Zone 1 — Open Core) is an open, offline-reproducible specification and verification harness establishing deterministic execution boundaries for autonomous AI agents interfacing with mutating external tools. AEIB prevents duplicate side-effects caused by prompt semantic drift during retry loops following post-dispatch transport severance (e.g., HTTP 504, TCP RST). Zone 1 provides the normative 15-vector wire fault-to-disposition mapping contract, RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) payload digest derivation, Canonical Action Identifier (CAID) mechanics, an industrial-protection-inspired software governor (probe-failure escalation, manual lockout latch, peer cancellation, retry-oscillation detector), an offline SCITT receipt verifier with 0-byte cloud egress, and a 500-episode reproducible benchmark suite (0/500 duplicate mutations, Rule-of-Three 95% upper bound of 0.60%). Distributed under the Apache License 2.0. Proprietary high-concurrency connection lease poolers, hardware enclave custody, and GRC regulatory reporting tools reside in Zone 2 under commercial licensing.
